title: Untitled Cam Heyward Documentary
overview: A look into the life and career of Pittsburgh Steelers star defensive tackle Cameron ‘Cam’ Heyward, a seven-time NFL Pro Bowler, four-time First-Team All-Pro, and recipient of the Walter Payton NFL Man of the Year Award. Explore the deep relationship Cam had with his late father, NFL legend Craig ‘Ironhead’ Heyward, who died at age 39 of brain cancer when Cam was just a high school sophomore. Known for his brute strength and punishing style, Ironhead Heyward made a name for himself as one of the best NFL running backs during the 1990s.
